schema.grading_fields: graded_on, what_happened, reasoning_unsealed (added when a prediction is graded)
schema.scoring: Brier vs outcome (hit=1, partial=0.5, miss=0); unresolvable excluded
schema.disclosure: Instruments A-G are sealed: reasoning is hash-committed and disclosed only at grading. Instruments H onward are NAMED and OPEN: the model, its repository and its full reasoning are public now, before the outcome. Both are pre-registered and graded the same way; they differ only in when the reasoning becomes readable.
